name: Guillaume de la Descorde
vampire_desc: Second son of a marcher lord, master of division and shifting alliances who became indispensable to lords who publicly condemned him.

memories.description: Born in 1182 to a minor marcher lord near a disputed frontier, Guillaume inherited little land but an instinct for division. By middle age, he had become a negotiator of truces that never fully hold, a patron of mercenaries, and a master of exploiting quarrels between neighboring houses. Chroniclers described him with admiration and unease in the same sentence.
